zh-CN.title: 探索者外观 · 小哀表情
items: 对方首条气泡的小哀表情移至右侧，自己的仍在左侧
带表情的首条气泡不再显示 APTX 药丸，后续气泡保留药丸装饰

en.title: Explorer styles · Ai expressions
items: Ai expressions move to the right of incoming first bubbles and remain on the left of your own
First bubbles with expressions no longer show an APTX capsule; later bubbles keep the capsule accent
